svg.aria-label: SNAKEYOS: AN OPERATING SYSTEM WRITTEN IN PYTHON. DESKTOP, BROWSER, 34 PYGAME APPS, OPENGL, AND PYWIN TO RUN WINDOWS PROGRAMS. X86_64 AND ARM64

g.text: An operating system written in Python.
Desktop · browser · 34 pygame apps · OpenGL · PyWin runs Windows .exe — even DOOM
x86_64 + ARM64 · PYKERNEL (RUST) + MICROPYTHON · NO LINUX · NO WINDOWS UNDERNEATH
